releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder support Custom weekday recurrence. All previous repeat options for each section, saved entries, snooze timing and limits, ringtone, notifications and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web update 327: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder saved-entry titles are 18px, written text is 16px, and entry details are 14px. Existing and future entries use the same readable sizing; saved data and reminder behavior are unchanged.
